sys_script.description: Before-update guard on x_casemgmt_case that enforces the forward-transition preconditions of the case state machine. On a status change it invokes the matching natively authored Flow Designer subflow (x_casemgmt.validate_open_transition, validate_in_progress_transition, validate_pending_transition, validate_resolved_transition, validate_closed_transition) synchronously with sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().inForeground(), then re-evaluates the same gate against the in-flight record through x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator and, on failure, calls gs.addErrorMessage() with the verbatim blocking message plus current.setAbortAction(true) so the error surfaces on the form. Order 250 runs after the Closed-terminal (100) and Any-to-Draft (200) prohibition guards and before the side-effect rules (300/400/500).
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions
